Declared principal geographic routes · WGS84 length estimates · nominal paths shown
East India Coastal: ≈ 1,800 km · sensitivity 1,800–1,900 km
West India Coastal: ≈ 1,800 km · sensitivity 1,700–1,800 km
Source: Schott/McCreary2001 section5.1. Declared coastal envelopes and southwest-monsoon principal route.
36 cases per current clear coarse land. Fine coast unchecked. Sensitivity is not annual variation.
